## What are cracking berries?

Popberries are bright red berries that explode when touched. They first shake briefly (although they can still be harvested) and then explode. They deal a small amount of fire damage and can no longer be harvested afterwards. In a nuclear missile impact zone / nuke zone, pop berries become raw cobalt flux.

Cracking berries can be used as an ingredient in various recipes, e.g. Berry Mentats and popping berry juice.
